influences.context: There's other songs, there's a Furry Lewis song called "Falling Down Blues," and it just reminds me of a field in August or something

influences.name: Neil Young
influences.context: After the Gold Rush is a pretty damn good record... That's just someone where it's like, "Wow," just to look into somebody who's still making great records... We got to do a European tour with him and Crazy Horse, and Bob Dylan came to one of the shows, which was amazing, I was standing on the side of the stage with Bob watching Neil Young

influences.name: R.E.M.
influences.context: we grew up liking R.E.M., we grew up liking Let's Active and the dB's and all these underground alternative bands. I remember when R.E.M. first came out and we heard "Radio Free Europe," there was a huge contingent of people in the South who, when Murmur came out... it really meant something to us... For three years we just listened to Murmur over and over, all the R.E.M. records, but especially Murmur.
